title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Logistic Roles - LocationRole
description: A location such as a hub or port can have different roles depending on the context (LogisticRoles:LocationRoles, FEDeRATED Logistic Roles ontology, republished inline in the SIMPLE LogisticRoles document). Modeled generically -- see the roleType property -- rather than as 17 separate entity types, since every concrete subclass (PlaceOfLoading, PortOfCall, PlaceOfDelivery, etc.) shares the exact same three required relationships and adds no property of its own beyond a differentiating label/comment.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LocationRole'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

roleType.description: Relationship. The specific LocationRoles subclass this location plays in this context (rdf:type in the source ontology, same treatment as brickClass in this repository's brick-schema candidate). PlaceOfDischarge is owl:equivalentClass to PlaceOfUnloading in the source -- both kept as distinct enum values since the source asserts both names. LocationRoles itself is included as the generic/unspecified role.

involvesLocation.description: Relationship. LogisticRoles:involves / simple-lr:involves (source uses one shared 'involves' predicate for all three related object types; split here into three separately-named relationships for validability). The physical location playing this role. Range: PhysicalInfrastructure:Location (out of scope of this candidate). Required: the source ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on 'involves' targeting PhysicalInfrastructure:Location for LocationRoles.

involvesTransportMeans.description: Relationship. LogisticRoles:involves / simple-lr:involves (see involvesLocation note on the shared source predicate). The transport means this location-role occurrence relates to. Range: DigitalTwin:TransportMeans (out of scope of this candidate). Required: the source ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on 'involves' targeting DigitalTwin:TransportMeans for LocationRoles.

involvesEvent.description: Relationship. LogisticRoles:involves / simple-lr:involves (see involvesLocation note on the shared source predicate). The logistics event this location-role occurrence relates to. Range: Event:Event (out of scope of this candidate). Required: the source ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on 'involves' targeting Event:Event for LocationRoles.
